params.name: SearchString
params.description: Free-text search across all promo code fields.

params.name: ProgramId
params.description: Filter by one or more program IDs.

params.name: AdvertiserId
params.description: Filter by one or more advertiser (brand) IDs.

params.name: DealId
params.description: Filter by one or more deal IDs.

params.name: CreatedDateStart
params.description: Return only codes created on or after this date/time (ISO 8601).

params.name: CreatedDateEnd
params.description: Return only codes created on or before this date/time (ISO 8601).

params.name: StartDateStart
params.description: Return only promo codes whose `StartDate` is on or after this date/time (ISO 8601).

params.name: StartDateEnd
params.description: Return only promo codes whose `StartDate` is on or before this date/time (ISO 8601).

params.name: EndDateStart
params.description: Return only promo codes whose `EndDate` is on or after this date/time (ISO 8601).

params.name: EndDateEnd
params.description: Return only promo codes whose `EndDate` is on or before this date/time (ISO 8601).

items.docs: Returns the promo codes available to your partner account. Supports filtering by program, advertiser, deal, credit rule, match mode, and creation date range.

params.description: The unique identifier assigned to the promo code.
